thread:
maya: FYI h100-nightly is red on the model-opt job, failing in the warmup with a weird kernel fault. Logs show `XID 79` then `invalid device function`.
adrian: ugh. which PR/commit? stacktrace or job link?
maya: job: https://ci.internal/runs/38291
maya: commit: 9f2d4b7 (model-opt: batchpad fix)
maya: paste of tail of dmesg:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (79): GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568901] nvidia: GPU reported: invalid device function
```
li: could be driver/ptx mismatch — did CI rollout a driver bump recently?
ci-bot: nightly-image h100-2026-03-17-rtc (driver 535.86) was promoted at 2026-03-16T22:10:03Z
adrian: thanks @ci-bot. @maya can you repro locally on an h100 debug node with the promoted image? quick check: `docker run --gpus all --rm -it image:h100-2026-03-17-rtc bash`
maya: trying now, will run the warmup binary and share logs. might take ~10m.
shelby: if it's ptx JIT incompat, a rerun pinned to the previous driver would help isolate. can we trigger a rerun with `image=h100-2026-03-15-rtc`?
adrian: yeah, schedule two reruns: one with current image and one pinned to older driver. also add `--gdb` to warmup so we can catch where it fails.
maya: local repro failed with same `invalid device function` immediately during kernel launch. attaching snippet:
```
GPU0 kernel_launch failed: cuBLASLtMatmul: unknown error (code -1)
Kernel: quant_attn_forward.cu:line 412
```
li: that lines up with kernel symbol mismatch. PR touches fused kernel params? model-opt change looked minor but might affect kernel template instantiation.
adrian: @maya can you bisect to the last green commit on nightly? quick bisect by triggering CI on commit ranges using the bisect job: `ci-bot bisect --job model-opt/h100-nightly --range 9f2d4b7..HEAD`
maya: kicked bisect via ci-bot
ci-bot: bisect started: https://ci.internal/bisect/6621
shelby: while bisecting, also add a smoke that runs warmup with `--small-shape` to catch regressions earlier.
li: good idea, add test to `smoke/h100` so future driver-image swaps catch this.
adrian: update the PR with a comment about potential kernel instantiation change and ask runtime folks to eyeball the diffs.
maya: bisect update: first failing commit is 9fc3a11, which changes launch params in quant-attn. reverting that locally makes the warmup pass.
adrian: ok looks like a real regression from that change. can you open a follow up PR reverting or fixing kernel templates and mark for urgent review?
maya: opened PR #4872 with revert + note: "revert quant-attn launch change — causes invalid device function on h100 with driver 535.86". tagging @eng-ml @eng-runtime
shelby: also filing an infra issue to pin drivers across the nightly pool until we confirm kernel compatibility. cc: @eng-infra
li: follow-up action: add a small CI matrix test that runs the warmup against both driver 535.86 and 533.50 images for h100 so we catch ABI mismatches.
adrian: sweet. thanks for the quick triage everyone. @ci-bot once revert PR merges, please trigger a full-nightly rerun and post results.
ci-bot: noted, will run after merge.
maya: will monitor and post results here. :thumbsup:
